parsed.name: BioShake微孔板恒温振荡器
parsed.description: 这是一种用于微孔板或样品板的台式加热振荡设备，可对样品进行温度控制并同时振荡混匀，常用于样品孵育、反应准备、混合和自动化实验流程。根据型号不同，设备还可能支持板夹锁定和主动冷却功能。
parsed.description_en: This is a benchtop heater shaker for microplates or sample plates. It provides temperature control together with shaking for sample mixing, incubation, reaction setup, and automated laboratory workflows. Depending on the model, it may also support plate locking and active cooling.
